body.statement: Under assignment positivity, the four marginal binomial sampling laws, validation transport, and the confidence-budget condition, \[\inf_{P\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{cl}}}\Pr_P\{K^{\star}\subseteq I_{\beta}\}\ge1-\beta.\] No mutual-independence condition on \(T_0,T_1,V_1,V_0\) is required. Coverage holds uniformly through optimizer ties, marginal contacts, and collapsed faces. Moreover, each endpoint of \(I_{\beta}\) is computable by a four-region profiling rule: the nontrivial root region uses the ten-point map, the two fractional regions use polygon vertices, and the constant region uses a feasibility check. Applied to \(\mathrm{def:kill-test-witness}\), the lower projection retains the legal edge value \(0.1320580555\) to the displayed precision.
body.justification: Exact primitive inversion avoids branchwise bootstrap failures and remains valid at every nonsmooth contact.
body.gap: GabrielSachsJensen2024 evaluates bootstrap coverage, documents regular-bootstrap undercoverage near boundaries, and reports a conservative \(m\)-out-of-\(n\) correction; FanPark2010 and KaidoMolinariStoye2019 provide adjacent clean-bound and generic projection inference. None gives exact simultaneous validation-binomial projection through the finite contact-complete shared-assay evaluator.
body.consumer: A prospective BNT162b2-style endpoint study with a blinded validation substudy obtains a uniformly valid confidence set for its full true-channel benefit interval.
